metadata.title: Analyze Codebase
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Explore affected files and components in the codebase using parallel exploration to identify files to create or modify, existing patterns, dependencies, integration points, and infrastructure or config changes needed.

output.description: Codebase analysis results organized by area: controllers, services, models, config, infra

prerequisites: Work item details available in memory from fetch-work-item step
specificActions: Follow the substeps below in sequence
Workflow: read context from memory → launch parallel explore subagents → group findings by area → store in memory → compliance check
Use parallel explore subagents to investigate different areas simultaneously for efficiency
Each subagent focuses on one area: files to create/modify, existing patterns, dependencies/integration points, infrastructure/config changes
Group all findings by area: controllers, services, models, config, infra

read: memory.json (work item details from fetch-work-item step)
Source code files identified during exploration

tools: Glob - Find files by name patterns across the codebase
Grep - Search for code patterns, references, and usages
Read - Read specific source code, config, and infra files
Agent - Launch parallel explore subagents for simultaneous investigation
bestPractices: Start broad and narrow down — search for keywords from the work item title and acceptance criteria first
Use parallel exploration to investigate multiple areas simultaneously instead of sequentially
Look for similar existing implementations to identify patterns the new code should follow
Check both the application code and infrastructure/config layers
Map upstream (what calls) and downstream (what is called) for affected components
Note naming conventions, folder structures, and module registration patterns
Keep findings structured and concise — reference file paths rather than copying large code blocks

substeps.name: Read implementation context from memory
substeps.description: Load work item details from memory to guide codebase exploration
actions: Read memory.json to get work item details from fetch-work-item step
Extract title, description, acceptance criteria, and detailed solution
Identify key terms, feature names, and domain concepts to search for
Formulate exploration strategy based on what the work item requires

substeps.name: Launch parallel explore subagents
substeps.description: Use parallel subagents to investigate different areas of the codebase simultaneously
actions: Subagent 1 — Files to create or modify: Search for existing files related to the feature domain. Identify files that need modification and gaps where new files are needed. Use Glob for file discovery and Grep for content matching.

Subagent 2 — Existing patterns to follow: Find similar implementations in the codebase. Note naming conventions, folder structures, module registration, dependency injection patterns. Identify the 'template' that new code should follow.

Subagent 3 — Dependencies and integration points: Map upstream callers and downstream callees for affected components. Identify external service integrations, event handlers, message consumers. Check for shared libraries or cross-cutting concerns.

Subagent 4 — Infrastructure and config changes: Check for infrastructure-as-code files (Terraform, CloudFormation, Docker). Review config files, environment variables, feature flags. Identify deployment or pipeline changes needed.

substeps.name: Group findings by area
substeps.description: Organize all exploration results into structured categories
actions: Group findings into: controllers (API layer), services (business logic layer), models (data/domain models), config (configuration and environment), infra (infrastructure, deployment, pipelines)
For each file identified, note: file path, change type (create/modify/extend), brief description of what needs to change
Consolidate dependency and integration point findings
Highlight patterns that new code must follow

substeps.name: Store analysis results in memory
substeps.description: Write structured codebase analysis to memory.json
actions: Write codebaseAnalysis object to current step's informationProduced section
Include: filesToCreate, filesToModify, existingPatterns, dependencies, integrationPoints, infraChanges, configChanges
Include groupedFindings organized by area (controllers, services, models, config, infra)
Document any assumptions or areas that need clarification

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
substeps.description: Verify principles were followed in this step
actions: Verify: Was log.json updated for any user interactions?
Verify: Were mandatory actions confirmed with output?
Verify: Findings are grouped by area and include file paths with change types
Output: 'Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Linear flow: Read work item context from memory -> Launch parallel explore subagents (4 concurrent investigations) -> Group all findings by area -> Store structured analysis in memory -> Compliance check.

fields: Information Produced: codebaseAnalysis object with filesToCreate, filesToModify, existingPatterns, dependencies, integrationPoints, infraChanges, configChanges, groupedFindings
Decisions Made: Exploration strategy, area grouping classifications
Notes: Assumptions, areas needing clarification, patterns identified

filesToCreate.description: New files that need to be created

existingPatterns.description: Patterns found in the codebase that new code should follow

integrationPoints.description: External services, events, and cross-cutting concerns

groupedFindings.description: All findings grouped by architectural area
